description: Address review feedback: fix subtitle reload losing playback position, add error state to TV player, fix HeroBanner timer leak, and add exports field to shared package.json.
steps: Fix VideoPlayer.jsx buildUrl to accept currentTime parameter, pass progressRef.current.time when subtitle changes
Add error state (hasError) and onError/onHttpError handlers to WebView with Retry TVFocusable button
Fix HeroBanner.jsx timer leak by adding mountedRef guard to pauseTimeoutRef callback and startAutoSlide
Add exports field to packages/shared/package.json mapping all deep import paths
acceptance_criteria: handleSubtitleSelect passes current playback time to buildUrl so resumeAt is included in rebuilt URL
WebView has onError and onHttpError handlers that show error state with Retry button
HeroBanner pauseTimeoutRef callback checks mountedRef before calling startAutoSlide
packages/shared/package.json has exports field with all subpath mappings
verification: bun build --no-bundle transpiles both JSX files without syntax errors
findings: All 4 review fixes applied. buildUrl now accepts optional currentTime param used by handleSubtitleSelect and handleRetry. Error state shows when WebView fails with a TVFocusable Retry button. HeroBanner uses mountedRef to prevent state updates after unmount. Shared package exports field maps all 11 subpaths.
